title: Room climate rule (data/room-climate.json)
description: The one source for which entities give an area's room temperature and humidity (area cards, the climate capsule, wall panel, TV tiles, widgets, watch). Per measure: entities of device_domains (thermostats) read device_attribute and come before sensors of sensor_device_class. Entities whose text matches an exclude group (fridge, freezer, cool box, pool, outdoor, boiler, water, processor ...) or whose registry entity_category is listed never count automatically; the admin may still pick one on purpose. Text = entity_id, the placement's display name, friendly_name and, where known (hub), the registry names and the device's name and model. Matching: lower case, ä→ae, ö→oe, ü→ue, ß→ss, other diacritics dropped, every run of other characters than a-z and 0-9 becomes one space; a keyword of contains matches anywhere (German compounds), one of prefixes only at the start of a word. Keywords are stored in that normalized form, with the spelling Home Assistant uses in entity ids (kuhlschrank) next to the transcribed one (kuehlschrank). docs/room-climate.md, reference tools/room_climate_ref.py. Generated as a constant for every language (codegen ContractData).

version.description: Raised on every change of this file.

entity_categories.description: Registry entity categories that never count automatically (hub only; apps do not see the registry).

id.description: Reason shown to the admin (Admin UI: why a sensor does not count).

contains.description: Normalized keywords that match anywhere in the text.

prefixes.description: Normalized keywords that match at the start of a word.
